title: ESTIMETR Traceable BOQ Estimation Workspace

scope: interactive ESTIMETR workspace with four gated stages
drawing/spec review, quantity evidence and unit-cost source states

workflow gate unit tests and browser/mobile validation record
verification: desktop stage progression and 375×812 mobile layout reviewed
security preflight, roadmap validation, diff check and public Vercel review pending
rollback: Return to tag v0.9.2-estimetr-terminology. This release has no migration, database write or user data to reverse.
